verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's docs describe an in-product AI that takes on delegated work. It can run in agentic mode with native function calling to search and follow links autonomously, and it can hand work to parallel sub-agents via the delegate_task tool. Scheduled prompts and automations let it run tasks unattended, and agent work is supervised with per-chat tool approval modes and Allow/Deny cards. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that task delegation works as documented, since all evidence is first-party docs.
